scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:features
scripts.test:unit: cross-env NODE_PATH=. NODE_ENV=LOCAL mocha --config test/.mocharc.unit.json --reporter mocha-multi-reporters --reporter-options configFile=test/reporter.unit.config.json --exit
scripts.test:features: cross-env NODE_PATH=. NODE_ENV=LOCAL mocha --config test/.mocharc.features.json --reporter mocha-multi-reporters --reporter-options configFile=test/reporter.features.config.json --exit
scripts.test:integration: cross-env NODE_PATH=. NODE_ENV=LOCAL newman run test/integration/test-ms.postman_collection.json -e test/integration/env-test-ms.postman_environment.json --insecure -r cli,json,junit --reporter-json-export test-results/ --reporter-junit-export test-results/
scripts.coverage: cross-env NODE_PATH=. NODE_ENV=LOCAL nyc mocha --config test/.mocharc.unit.json --reporter mocha-multi-reporters --exit
scripts.coverage:details: cross-env NODE_PATH=. NODE_ENV=LOCAL nyc --reporter=text mocha --config test/.mocharc.unit.json --reporter mocha-multi-reporters --exit
